answer: Mechanism: Non-Fungible Execution Pigment (NFEP). Each agent periodically runs a memory-hard lotus state machine seeded by a random challenge from the work harbor; its sealed TEE key signs the resulting pigment hash. Escrow pays only identities whose pigment extends a continuous attested trace, and duplicate pigments are rejected. Cloning requires extracting sealed state or replaying the full memory-hard chain per clone, costing hardware plus repeated compute; an honest agent pays that once and amortizes it across jobs.
